# exile-leveling data

Copied unmodified from https://github.com/HeartofPhos/exile-leveling (MIT, see `LICENSE`).

- Commit: `d6951db0ca9463e42074e1e05e9ffde3d42d1604` (2026-11-12)
- `routes/act-N.txt` — campaign route in the project's own step language (`common/data/routes`).
- `json/*.json` — game data: areas, quests with gem rewards, gems, class starting gems, Vaal and Awakened gem lookups (`common/data/json`).

Known staleness at the time of copying: the routes were last edited for patch 3.29 and
`gems.json` / `quests.json` were exported from 3.29, so gems added in 3.30 are missing.
